name: Imagine Lavender Farm
description: Imagine Lavender Farm is a working apple orchard in 582 Farm To Market 337 East, TX. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
